feature.label: PostGIS files import and export
feature.description: Import and export of files (GeoJSON, FlatGeobuf, Shapefile, KML, CSV...) in the PostgreSQL/PostGIS connections of DBeaver, from the Database Navigator. Uses the file drivers of H2GIS: requires the H2GIS driver feature.
